extras.label: Myocardium (wall of heart)
extras.description: Heart wall. Tinted by approximate coronary perfusion territory.

extras.label: Right coronary artery (RCA)
extras.description: Runs in the right atrioventricular groove; supplies the right ventricle and, usually, the inferior wall.

extras.label: Left circumflex (LCX)
extras.description: Runs in the left atrioventricular groove; supplies the lateral and posterolateral wall.

extras.label: Left anterior descending (LAD)
extras.description: Runs in the anterior interventricular groove; supplies the anterior wall and anterior two-thirds of the septum.

extras.label: Left main coronary artery
extras.description: Common trunk feeding LAD and LCX. Not separately predicted; shown with the higher of the LAD / LCX risks.
